statement_pretty:
∀ {X : Type} [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace X] {Y : Type} {s : Set Y},
  s.Finite →
    ∀ {f : Y → Set X},
      (∀ i ∈ s, IsClopen (f i)) →
        ⋃ x ∈ (⋂ i ∈ s, f i) ∪ ⋂ i ∈ s, f i, connectedComponent x =
          (⋂ i ∈ s, f i) ∪ ⋂ i ∈ s, f i

referees.justification: The 3-step synthesis across Set, IsClopen resists single-lemma lookup and yields a proof-to-statement ratio of 0.70, meriting archival as a theorem. While its immediate utility outside the present formal context remains speculative, the structural coupling of hypotheses is unexpectedly persistent.

Although the statement clears the Level 1 lookup gate across Set, IsClopen, the conclusion reads primarily as an accidental consequence of chaining 3 library facts. I recommend publication solely as a lemma of modest significance (4/10), noting that the kernel's indifference to mathematical taste is on full display.
